zero_shot_mutant_candidates.project: Mutant candidate summary: mutation (keep the tool's original notation), source model, score/confidence, recommendation/rationale; positions overlapping the active site are marked as not recommended
zero_shot_mutant_candidates.form: Markdown table; score column names restated in natural language, not raw JSON key names
zero_shot_mutant_candidates.downstream: result_files list -> summarize_result; ConSurf conservation / EasIFA active site / PubMed literature are annotations only, not recommendation criteria
zero_shot_mutant_candidates.output_template:
- Title: **Zero-shot mutant candidate prediction result**
- Markdown table: `| Mutation | Source model | Score/confidence | Recommendation/rationale |`, keeping the tool's original mutation/model notation; column names adjustable per resultjson
- Positions overlapping the active site -> mark as "Overlaps active site, not recommended"; conservation is only a note in the rationale column
- If PubMed reports the mutation: note the PMID and distinguish "reported hotspot" / "new target not yet reported"
- Never invent evidence not present in the data; do not use raw JSON key names as body text

structure_to_sequence.downstream: sequence can be used as protein_sequence for downstream mutation/design/annotation endpoints (e.g. consensus_mutation, interpro_analyze)
structure_to_sequence.output_template:
- Title: **Structure-to-sequence extraction result**
- Lead with the conclusion: extracted protein sequence for chain=<chain> (length N aa)
- Show the sequence as inline code; no download needed

fasta_to_sequence.downstream: sequence can be used as downstream protein_sequence input
fasta_to_sequence.output_template:
- Title: **FASTA sequence parsing result**
- Lead with the conclusion: parsed sequence id/length
- Show the sequence as inline code

protein_design.project: Designed sequences with scores, download_url (design results), zip_download_url
protein_design.form: Download link list; structure files given as `[name](full URL)` per format
protein_design.output_template:
- Title: **Protein design result (RFdiffusion3 + MPNN)**
- Lead with the conclusion: number of designed sequences / scores
- Add design-result and scaffold-file links to the "Result files & downloads" section: `[Design result file](download_url)`, `[ZIP](zip_download_url)`

rfd3_design.project: structure_links (best ≤5 scaffold PDBs sorted by sample_score) with structures overview (chain/length/sequence/sample_score/quality metrics)
rfd3_design.form: Scaffold PDB link list; quality metrics include insertion RMSD, clashes, chain breaks, secondary structure
rfd3_design.downstream: scaffolds can feed mpnn_design_sequence / protein_design for sequence design
rfd3_design.output_template:
- Title: **RFdiffusion3 protein scaffold design result**
- Lead with the conclusion: number of scaffolds generated (best ≤5), sample_score range
- Add scaffold PDB links to the "Result files & downloads" section; summarize quality metrics in text (insertion RMSD/clashes/chain breaks/secondary structure)

protenix.project: Predicted structure download_url (.cif/.pdb) with confidence: plddt, ptm, gpde, num_recycles, has_clash
protenix.downstream: structure can serve as downstream structure_file, or extract the sequence first via structure_to_sequence and use as protein_sequence
protenix.output_template:
- Title: **Protenix structure prediction result**
- Lead with the conclusion: prediction done + confidence (plddt/ptm/gpde), num_recycles, clash status
- Add the structure file link to the "Result files & downloads" section: `[Protenix structure prediction result file](download_url)`

multievolve.project: Multi-site combinatorial mutation activity score topk (download_url)
multievolve.output_template:
- Title: **Multi-site mutation activity prediction result**
- Lead with the conclusion: recommended combinatorial mutations and activity-score trend (topk)
- Add the full ranking to the "Result files & downloads" section

ephod_predict_protein.output_template:
- Title: **Protein optimal pH prediction result**
- Lead with the conclusion: optimal pH range per protein
- Add details to the "Result files & downloads" section

ephod_predict_mutation.project: Optimal pH per mutant and its change (download_url)
ephod_predict_mutation.output_template:
- Title: **Mutant optimal pH prediction result**
- Lead with the conclusion: optimal pH per mutant and differences vs wild type
- Add details to the "Result files & downloads" section

protein_sol_predict_protein.project: Protein solubility and isoelectric point pI (download_url)
protein_sol_predict_protein.output_template:
- Title: **Protein solubility prediction result**
- Lead with the conclusion: predicted solubility trend and pI
- Add details to the "Result files & downloads" section

protein_sol_predict_mutation.project: Solubility score per mutant and change trend; flag mutations likely to affect solubility
protein_sol_predict_mutation.output_template:
- Title: **Mutant solubility prediction result**
- Lead with the conclusion: solubility score/change trend, flagging mutations likely to affect solubility
- Add details to the "Result files & downloads" section

summarize_result.project: Multi-model summarized ranking (topk) with all rows retained; restated as a table with the tool's original fields, prompting download of the full file when too long
summarize_result.form: Full Markdown table (≤100 rows); better for filtering/sorting
summarize_result.downstream: final step of the mutation-prediction chain (terminal)
summarize_result.output_template:
- Title: **Multi-model result summary**
- Show the full summary table (≤100 rows, no truncation), column names restated in natural language
- Lead with the conclusion: positions where models agree/disagree; base final recommendations on the summary rather than restating single-model raw tables
- When more than 100 rows, prompt downloading the full file

protein_evolution.project: Activity score topk for specified n-site/multi-site mutations (download_url)
protein_evolution.output_template:
- Title: **Protein n-site mutation activity prediction result**
- Lead with the conclusion: n-site/multi-site mutation activity prediction results (topk)
- Add details to the "Result files & downloads" section

protrek_search.project: Hit protein entries, similarity and functional information
protrek_search.downstream: for known targets with metadata use uniprot_query; this endpoint is for open-ended retrieval
protrek_search.output_template:
- Title: **ProTrek database search result**
- Lead with the conclusion: number of hit protein entries; list similarity per hit (score vs query) and functional information
- For structure/sequence search, state the retrieval mode (query_type/input_type)

catpred_predict.project: kcat, Km, kcat/Km predictions (restate resultjson per the actual keys returned)
catpred_predict.output_template:
- Title: **Enzyme kinetic parameter prediction result (CatPred)**
- Lead with the conclusion: predicted kcat, Km, kcat/Km and trends
- Restate key parameters in natural language or a small table

easifa_predict_active_site.project: Enzyme active-site/binding-site residues, positions and confidence; positions overlapping zero-shot mutant results are marked as not recommended for engineering
easifa_predict_active_site.downstream: site information cross-annotated with zero_shot_mutant_candidates overlap
easifa_predict_active_site.output_template:
- Title: **Enzyme active-site/binding-site prediction result (EasIFA)**
- Lead with the conclusion: active-site residues, positions, confidence
- When zero-shot mutant results exist, mark overlapping positions (overlaps not recommended for engineering)

foldseek.downstream: sequence can serve as downstream protein_sequence input
foldseek.output_template:
- Title: **Foldseek structure search result**
- Lead with the conclusion: sequence extraction summary (length)
- Add sequence inline code + FASTA link to the "Result files & downloads" section

generate_msa.form: Download link; note MSA can be used for homology/conservation inference
generate_msa.downstream: download_url -> msa_file for consensus_mutation / evcouplings_mutation / zero_shot_mutant_candidates
generate_msa.output_template:
- Title: **Multiple sequence alignment (MSA) result**
- Lead with the conclusion: MSA computed, usable for homology and conservation inference
- Add the MSA file link to the "Result files & downloads" section and note it can serve as downstream msa_file

mpnn_design_sequence.project: Number of designed sequences, scores/confidence, download_url
mpnn_design_sequence.output_template:
- Title: **MPNN sequence design result**
- Lead with the conclusion: number of designed sequences and scores/confidence
- Add the design-result file link to the "Result files & downloads" section

catapro_predict.project: Enzyme kinetic parameters kcat, Km, kcat/Km predictions
catapro_predict.output_template:
- Title: **Enzyme kinetic parameter prediction result (CataPro)**
- Lead with the conclusion: predicted kcat, Km, kcat/Km (may include trends)

esmfold2_predict.project: Complex structure download_url (.cif, composition when protein+DNA/RNA/ligand) with confidence: plddt_mean, ptm, iptm, sequence_length
esmfold2_predict.downstream: structure can serve as downstream structure_file
esmfold2_predict.output_template:
- Title: **ESMFold2 structure prediction result**
- Lead with the conclusion: prediction done (complex composition, e.g. protein(47aa)+dna(12nt)) and confidence (plddt_mean/ptm/iptm), sequence_length
- Add the structure CIF link to the "Result files & downloads" section

consurf_predict.project: Conserved residue count and list (pos/seq/conserved_rank/conserved_score); presented grouped by conservation level
consurf_predict.form: Residue list; interpretation: lower conserved_score = more conserved, larger conserved_rank = more conserved
consurf_predict.downstream: conservation is only a reference annotation for the zero_shot_mutant_candidates recommendation rationale, not a recommendation criterion
consurf_predict.output_template:
- Title: **Residue conservation analysis result (ConSurf)**
- Interpretation: larger conserved_rank = more conserved (7/8/9 conserved, 1/2/3 variable); lower conserved_score = more conserved
- List positions grouped as conserved/variable (pos/residue/rank/score), explaining the functional or engineering significance of conserved/variable regions
- May provide conservation reference notes for the "Recommendation/rationale" column of zero_shot_mutant_candidates (annotation only, not a recommendation criterion)

interpro_analyze.project: Domain, family, GO annotation summary + Excel (download_url)
interpro_analyze.form: Annotation summary text + Excel download link
interpro_analyze.output_template:
- Title: **InterProScan domain and function annotation result**
- Lead with the conclusion: key domain/family/GO annotation entries
- Add the Excel detail file to the "Result files & downloads" section

dock.project: affinity per pose (binding energy, kcal/mol), rmsd_lb/rmsd_ub, associated pocket; rank-1 carries pdb_url (clean complex); best score read from message or the minimal affinity
dock.form: Pose list text (affinity & RMSD) + multi-conformer PDB download link
dock.output_template:
- Title: **Molecular docking result**
- Lead with the conclusion: best score (best affinity, kcal/mol) and the associated pocket
- List poses sorted by score (affinity/rmsd_lb/rmsd_ub, mark the pocket when multiple pockets)
- Add the multi-conformer PDB to the "Result files & downloads" section; give rank-1 pdb_url separately (usable as PLIP input)

caver_tunnel_analyze.project: Tunnel/channel location, length, bottleneck residues + visualization/download links
caver_tunnel_analyze.output_template:
- Title: **Protein tunnel/channel analysis result (CAVER)**
- Lead with the conclusion: tunnel/channel location, length, bottleneck residues
- Add visualization outputs to the "Result files & downloads" section

bfitter.project: Distribution of high/low B-factor positions and engineering implications
bfitter.downstream: flexible positions can be annotated as site-directed mutagenesis/directed-evolution candidates
bfitter.output_template:
- Title: **Protein flexibility analysis result (B-FITTER)**
- Lead with the conclusion: distribution of high (flexible) / low (rigid) B-factor positions
- Explain what flexible regions imply for site-directed mutagenesis / directed evolution

pubmed_search.project: extracted_papers and summary; table grouped by PMID (protein name, mutation (original notation), key finding, source reference)
pubmed_search.form: Markdown table; keep original mutation notation (e.g. Y126A/Y206F); site-level comparison only when zero-shot mutant results exist and the literature contains those mutations
pubmed_search.downstream: literature evidence can be cross-checked with zero_shot_mutant_candidates positions (note the PMID, distinguish reported hotspots/new targets)
pubmed_search.output_template:
- Title: **PubMed literature search result**
- Lead with a review summary: 4-6 bullet points depending on focus (mutation/engineering vs application/mechanism)
- Table grouped by PMID with the source reference in the last column (`PMID: XXXXXXXX`, fall back to the title when missing); keep original mutation notation
- Papers with empty mutations do not show mutation-related columns; site-level comparison only when zero-shot mutant results exist and the literature contains those mutations

pubchem_search.project: Compound entries: name, synonyms, molecular_formula, molecular_weight, canonical_smiles, inchi, inchikey, cid, pubchem_url
pubchem_search.downstream: canonical_smiles -> smiles / primary_smiles for catpred_predict / catapro_predict
pubchem_search.output_template:
- Title: **PubChem compound search**
- Lead with the conclusion: compound name, molecular formula, molecular weight
- Also give: canonical_smiles / InChIKey, cid, `[PubChem entry](pubchem_url)` (URL in a safe form)
- Avoid listing every JSON key

pisa_query.project: n_interfaces and per interface: interface_id, interface_area, solvation_energy, stabilization_energy, p_value, hydrogen_bonds, salt_bridges, n_interface_residues, key interface residues
pisa_query.form: Interface summary text/table + full JSON download link
pisa_query.downstream: key interface residues can be used for interaction annotation
pisa_query.output_template:
- Title: **PISA protein interface analysis result**
- Lead with the conclusion: number of interfaces (n_interfaces) and stability (p_value/stabilization energy)
- Per interface give interface_area, solvation/stabilization energy, p_value, hydrogen bond/salt bridge counts, n_interface_residues, key interface residues
- Add the full interface JSON to the "Result files & downloads" section

plip_analyze.project: Protein-ligand interactions: hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic contacts, salt bridges, pi-pi stacking etc. + summary + download_url
plip_analyze.downstream: input is often the rank-1 pdb_url returned by dock
plip_analyze.output_template:
- Title: **PLIP protein-ligand interaction analysis result**
- Lead with the conclusion: detected interaction categories (hydrogen bond/hydrophobic/salt bridge/pi-pi/halogen/metal coordination) and key residues
- Add result files and visualizations to the "Result files & downloads" section; note the source structure when the input came from dock

uniprot_query.project: protein_name, organism, sequence_length, sequence, structure_links, function-related fields
uniprot_query.form: Metadata summary (name/species/length) + sequence inline code + structure links
uniprot_query.output_template:
- Title: **UniProt query result**
- Lead with the conclusion: protein name, species, sequence length, function annotation and key regions (summarized, not raw JSON key names)
- Show the full sequence as inline code; structure_links as `[name](full URL)`
- Note the sequence can serve as downstream protein_sequence input

uniprot_batch_query.project: Metadata per query id (uniprotkb/uniparc, name, species, sequence length, structure_links)
uniprot_batch_query.downstream: sequence of the selected entry can be used as downstream input
uniprot_batch_query.output_template:
- Title: **UniProt candidate match result**
- One row per candidate entry: Entry/protein name/species/sequence identity/sequence length (table or list)
- Prompt the user to confirm the selection

pocket_prediction.project: n_pockets and pockets list (rank/name/score/probability/center/residue_ids/n_residues) + cropped pocket PDB download_url
pocket_prediction.form: Pocket list + link; n_pockets=0 is a valid result (p2rank found no pocket), not a failure
pocket_prediction.downstream: cropped pocket PDB (download_url) -> structure_file for rfd3_design
pocket_prediction.output_template:
- Title: **Binding pocket prediction result**
- Lead with the conclusion: number of pockets, per-pocket score/probability, location of the top ones (center and residues)
- Add the cropped pocket PDB to the "Result files & downloads" section and note it can feed rfd3_design
- Report n_pockets=0 truthfully (p2rank found no pocket), not a failure

consensus_mutation.project: Consensus mutation residues, support level and recommendation grade
consensus_mutation.output_template:
- Title: **Consensus mutation analysis result**
- Lead with the conclusion: positions jointly recommended by multiple models/homolog sequences, support level and overall recommendation grade

evcouplings_mutation.project: Single-site mutation statistical energy scores (Excel download_url) + zip_download_url (.model and coupling parameters)
evcouplings_mutation.output_template:
- Title: **EVcouplings coevolutionary mutation analysis result**
- Lead with the conclusion: TOP positions by single-site statistical energy score
- Add the Excel and ZIP (with .model/coupling parameters) to the "Result files & downloads" section

crop_sequence.project: cropped_results: name/start/end/length/sequence per region + merged FASTA download_url
crop_sequence.output_template:
- Title: **Protein sequence cropping result**
- One entry per region: range (start-end) and cropped sequence (inline code)
- Add the merged FASTA to the "Result files & downloads" section

dock_score.project: best_score (total binding energy kcal/mol), per-term energy breakdown, box_size/center, mode=score_only
dock_score.output_template:
- Title: **Vina single-pose scoring result**
- Lead with the conclusion: best_score (kcal/mol) and the box used (center/box_size)
- Give the energy breakdown (gauss/hydrophobic/hbond etc., restated per returned keys)

surface_charge.project: Charge summary: negative_surface / positive_surface / net_surface_charge / surface_residues / patch_count / patches; residues[] details (sasa/pka/charge_type/is_surface)
surface_charge.form: Text/table; when APBS is unavailable status=partial — report only ProCaliper results and explain why; download_url is the .dx grid (when APBS available)
surface_charge.output_template:
- Title: **Surface residue charge analysis result (ProCaliper + APBS)**
- Lead with the conclusion: net charge (positive/negative/net_surface_charge), surface residue count, charge patch count
- List key surface positive/negative-charge residues (with pKa/sasa)
- When APBS is unavailable (status=partial) state plainly that electrostatics were not solved and report only ProCaliper results; add the .dx grid (if any) to the "Result files & downloads" section

reap_design_primer.project: Primer design table (mutation id, forward/reverse primer sequences, Tm) + Excel download_url + ZIP zip_download_url
reap_design_primer.output_template:
- Title: **Single-site mutation primer design result (REAP Step 7)**
- Markdown table: `| Mutation ID | Forward primer | Reverse primer | Tm |`
- Add the Excel and ZIP to the "Result files & downloads" section
